newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CETES RATE PARES FALLS ON LONG BOND WOES.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CETES RATE PARES FALLS ON LONG BOND WOES.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates ended down 40 basis points at 18.80 percent on Tuesday after zigzagging through a volatile session, dealers said.
Dealers said rates ended above a session low of 18.00 percent on market jitters triggered by a late rise in U.S. long bond yields to 6.68 percent.
"Players are speculating and are a little nervous over U.S. retail sales data tomorrow, in case they show signs the U.S. economy is ovrheating," a trader said.
Dealers said they were also cautious due to expected rate hikes at the central bank auction later in the day.
